reasoning_content: The process-compose server is responding on port 8080 (swagger redirect confirmed). Workers are initializing. I'll wait for more services to be ready and then check the health endpoint.

action.command: sleep 120; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "8080 swagger: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/swagger/index.html; echo "=== process states (grep logs) ==="; grep -E "process state|process (stopped|healthy|ready)" /tmp/process-compose.log 2>/dev/null | tail -5; echo "=== readiness via /docs ==="; for p in 18000 18001 18002 18003 18005 18006 18007 18008 18009 18010 18011 18012 18013 18014 18015 18016 18020 18021 18022 18024 3002; do code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -m 3 http://localhost:$p/docs 2>/dev/null); echo "port $p: $code"; done
